note: Copy this to .advocate/evaluator.json and set AIRP_EVALUATOR_CONFIG to that path. Fetch the GGUF first with npm run fetch:evaluator-model. The digest must match data/models/manifest.json; construction refuses to load on mismatch. Response content does not leave the device. Temperature 0 and a fixed seed are applied by the evaluator. GPU offload is optional and never required.
